note: Gains locked in (compare.py): each workload must cost at most atMost times another of the same run, in the same unit. Measured on macOS (wall clock) when set: layout/5000/change 0.007 of layout/5000, frame/blink/400/drawn 0.21 of frame/400, frame/blink/400 0.46 of frame/400; the limits leave room for runners and callgrind. forge/type 0.036, forge/switch-tab 0.037 and forge/palette 0.071 of forge/open.

locks.name: layout/5000/change
locks.why: one changed panel lays out only what it moves, not the whole tree

locks.name: frame/blink/400/drawn
locks.why: a blinking caret redraws only its damage region

locks.name: frame/blink/400
locks.why: a frame where nothing but the caret changed reuses the cached draw list

locks.name: forge/type
locks.why: a character typed into Forge's editor updates what reads that file, not the workbench

locks.name: forge/switch-tab
locks.why: switching Forge's tab rebuilds one editor group, not the workbench

locks.name: forge/palette
locks.why: opening and filtering Forge's command palette builds the palette alone
